guarded_patterns.explanation: Writing to .beads/ in a shared checkout risks concurrent corruption. This check denies writes to .beads/ paths when the repository root has .git as a directory (the shared/primary tree where concurrent workers operate), but allows writes when .git is a file (a linked worktree, which by construction is not the shared tree).

redirect.reason_template: Hand-editing .beads/ in a shared checkout is blocked. This repository's .git is a directory, indicating it's the shared primary tree where concurrent worker corruption can occur. Use 'git worktree add --detach <dir> origin/main' to create a linked worktree for .beads/ work instead. See CLAUDE.md: 'Never hand-edit anything under .beads/'
